patch_description:
This crossover keeps the strongest ideas from the prior variants while simplifying the feature set toward short-horizon, regime-invariant signals.  
Key changes:
- shorter lookbacks dominate the feature space
- rolling z-scores and ranks are used to reduce regime dependence
- explicit “market character change” features are included: volatility trend, efficiency trend, autocorrelation trend
- momentum × volatility and volume × price-location interactions are preserved because they generalized better than raw level features alone
- model regularization is relaxed slightly to reduce prediction collapse while keeping overfit in check

The result is designed to improve validation slope and prediction dispersion without exceeding the feature budget or using any future data.
